function.arguments: {"citations":[{"body":0,"claim":"First violating step: pole angle theta=-0.987 rad exceeds 0.8 rad upright limit; cart at x=1.345 with controller saturated at 30.","field":"x","step":12,"value":1.345298194189224},{"body":0,"claim":"One step before violation the pole was still inside limit (theta=-0.789) with cart at x=1.13 accelerating under saturated force.","field":"x","step":11,"value":1.1321689252964129},{"body":-1,"claim":"System energy at violating step consistent with large controller work input.","field":"energy","step":12,"value":40.75957529018947}],"explanation":"Noisy sensor (0.02) with coarse dt=0.02, light cart (0.5kg) and initial offset (v=0.5, theta=0.2) causes state-feedback controller to saturate at force_limit and drive cart to high velocity (~10.9 m/s). The saturated bang-bang-like action pumps energy faster than the pole dynamics can be stabilized, so theta diverges from -0.60 (step10) to -0.789 (step11) to -0.988 (step12), breaching pole_upright. Likely cause: controller gains adapted to plant but not robust to combined sensor noise + large dt discretization + saturation, leading to destabilizing positive feedback.","rule":"pole_upright","scenario_id":"sbff3ed7c45"}
